blocking_findings.issue: Probable wrong canonical scripture identity: the verse 'And all the people perceived the thunderings…' is bound as source urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:exodus/20/18, with corresp .../quotes/exodus_20/18 and intro id intro_exodus_20_18. That is the English/KJV verse number. In Hebrew (Masoretic) numbering this verse is Exodus 20:15, and Hebrew 20:18 is a different verse. The same record uses Hebrew numbering for the Psalms (psalms/47/6, psalms/81/4, psalms/81/5; in KJV numbering these are 47:5, 81:3 and 81:4). So the versification is mixed within one record, and the Exodus binding most likely follows the publication's or the English versification instead of the canonical one.
blocking_findings.required_action: Confirm which versification the canonical bible namespace uses. If it is Masoretic, rebind source, corresp, chapter wrapper and intro id to exodus/20/15, and fix the Hebrew counterpart and any shared canonical ids to match.

blocking_findings.issue: Canonical condition identities look publication-specific and language-specific. Both wording_selection and source_fidelity.settings use urn:x-opensiddur:condition:prayer:areshet_sefatenu/conclusion/{en,he}/first_printing and .../{en,he}/zikhronot_printing. These sit in the canonical prayer condition namespace but are named after where the variant was printed in this edition ('first_printing', 'zikhronot_printing'), and they are split by translation language (en/he). As a result the Hebrew realization sets English-language conditions and the English realization sets Hebrew ones. Only teqiot_veseder_shofarot reads like a liturgical variant identity.
blocking_findings.required_action: Either show that these condition URNs were already accepted as canonical identities and describe a real liturgical or wording distinction, or rename them to content-based canonical variant identities. Translation-specific wording choices should live in the translation or publication layer, not as language-keyed canonical prayer conditions.

verdict: Not approved. I read all seven files and completed every assigned metadata check. There are two blocking issues. (1) The shofarot verses record binds 'all the people perceived the thunderings' to bible:exodus/20/18, which is the English/KJV number, while using Masoretic numbering for the Psalms in the same record; the canonical verse is most likely Exodus 20:15. (2) The areshet_sefatenu wording conditions are canonical prayer conditions named after where this edition printed the variant and split by language (en/he first_printing / zikhronot_printing). The ken_tagen_words and areshet_zikhron_words records show no binding or identity defects on their own.
